hurwitz_units.note: the 24 units of the Hurwitz order = the 24 norm-1 vectors of D_4 = the binary tetrahedral group 2T

D4_lattice.control_note: the same exhaustive routine returns 48 and 384 on the controls, so 1152 is not produced by construction

homomorphism.map: phi(q) : v |-> q v qbar on purely imaginary quaternions, basis (i, j, k); kernel {+-1}
homomorphism.note: order 12, NOT 24.  The control group is therefore C_12.

orbit_structure_and_frame_shapes.frame_shapes_quoted: LeanMaster v3.28.0 docs/VERIFIED_FOUNDATION.md:194-195: "The 192 elements of `(Z_2)^4 |x A_4` act as distinct automorphisms of `H^2(Km A, Q)`. Their Frame shapes, from Lefschetz numbers of powers, are `1^24, 1^8 2^8, 1^6 3^6, 1^4 2^2 4^4` (1, 27, 128, 36 elements): classes `1A, 2A, 3A, 4B`, all geometric."

comparison_where_meaningful.2A_order_2: matched in element order: 3 elements of order 2 in phi(2T) (the coordinate-axis pi rotations)
comparison_where_meaningful.3A_order_3: matched in element order: 8 elements of order 3 in phi(2T) (the body-diagonal 2pi/3 rotations)
comparison_where_meaningful.4B_order_4: NOT MATCHED and cannot be.  phi(2T) = A_4 has no element of order 4: the order-4 quaternion units +-i, +-j, +-k map under phi to rotations by pi, i.e. order 2.  The order-4 structure lives in the double cover 2T and in the (Z_2)^4 factor, neither of which acts on S^2.  This is the boundary of where the Frame-shape comparison is meaningful; it is stated, not fudged.

orbit_structure_and_frame_shapes.element_count_note: the counts 1, 27, 128, 36 are of the order-192 group, not of its A_4 quotient; phi(2T) has 1, 3, 8 elements of orders 1, 2, 3.  No claim is made that these agree.

wigner_known_answer.note: trace(D^l(R)) = chi_l(theta_R) is convention-independent, so together with the homomorphism property it pins the representation to the rotation it is meant to represent.

rotation_vs_pixel_sphere.test: band-limited lmax=8 map, my D applied in harmonic space vs bilinear interpolation of T at R^{-1}n
rotation_vs_pixel_sphere.note: the tolerance 5e-3 was fixed a priori and is NOT relaxed. The first attempt used an nside-64 interpolation reference and gave 6.9e-3, i.e. at the level of HEALPix bilinear interpolation error itself; the REFERENCE was then refined to nside 512 (same band-limited function, ~64x smaller interpolation error) and the test is judged at the same 5e-3. Both numbers are reported. The decisive convention checks are the exact ones above: D(R1)D(R2) = D(R1R2) and trace D^l(R) = chi_l(theta_R), both at ~1e-13; a wrong convention would fail those by O(1).
